A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a non-local means for Poisson noisy images, which is guided by two images, one being the noisy image and the other one a prefiltered noisy image.
we extend NL means to Poisson noise and propose a fast automatic selection of the two parameters of our algorithm.

we propose a new method that extends NL-means to the case of Poisson noise, we show how the method can be tuned and automatically selected and that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art.
